$comment: Curated visa pathways. Sources verified 2026-09-08 against official government pages (immi.homeaffairs.gov.au, canada.ca IEC, uscis.gov H-2 list). eligibleNationalities: ISO-3166 alpha-2; null = open to all nationalities. Update lastVerifiedAt when re-checked.

pathways.name: Work and Holiday visa (subclass 462)
pathways.workRights: Full work rights; max 6 months per employer (extensions for specified work)
pathways.notes: Annual caps apply; some countries require education credentials or a ballot. Education requirement varies by country (degree or 2 years of undergraduate study for most).

pathways.name: Working Holiday visa (subclass 417)
pathways.duration: 12 months (extendable to 2–3 years with specified work)
pathways.workRights: Full work rights; max 6 months per employer
pathways.notes: Second and third year visas require specified regional work.

pathways.name: Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482)
pathways.workRights: Employer-sponsored; occupation must be on the relevant skills list; pathways to PR
pathways.notes: Requires an approved employer sponsor — filter jobs by 'Visa support reported'.

pathways.name: International Experience Canada — Working Holiday
pathways.duration: Up to 12–24 months depending on country
pathways.workRights: Open work permit; no job offer required
pathways.notes: Annual pools are competitive; candidates enter a pool and receive invitations to apply.

pathways.name: International Experience Canada — Young Professionals
pathways.duration: Up to 12–24 months depending on country
pathways.workRights: Closed (employer-specific) work permit; a job offer in TEER 0–3 is required
pathways.notes: Mexico is eligible for Young Professionals and International Co-op only (no Working Holiday).

pathways.name: Temporary Foreign Worker Program (LMIA-backed)
pathways.workRights: Employer-specific permit; employer must obtain an LMIA or LMIA exemption
pathways.notes: Filter jobs by 'Visa support reported' to find employers used to hiring internationally.

pathways.name: Study permit — part-time work & co-op
pathways.workRights: Up to 24 h/week off-campus during sessions; full-time during scheduled breaks; co-op permits for required internships

pathways.name: H-2B — Temporary Non-Agricultural Workers
pathways.duration: Up to 1 year, extendable to a maximum of 3 years
pathways.workRights: Temporary employment with a petitioning US employer (DOL temporary labor certification required)
pathways.notes: Eligible-country list above is the subset most relevant to our audience; Mongolia is H-2B only. See the official page for the full list.

pathways.name: Student visa (subclass 500) — work while studying
pathways.workRights: Up to 48 hours per fortnight during study; unlimited during scheduled breaks
